text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin!!
The winner is Narita Taishin!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Unleashing a demonic late charge from that petite frame!
The winner of the Satsuki Sho, the first leg of the Classic Triple Crown,
is none other than Narita Taishin!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: My name...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOO!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Taishin! Taishin!
That was awesomeee!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (...They're watching.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Everyone... is watching me...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Aaaahhhhhh!!
And then, she let out a roar.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Did you see that?! Did you see that...?! Did you see that, damn it!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Take that!!
The place where I belong... is right here!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Um—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I'm home.

"‘That was an amazing run!’
I wanted to express it with all the words I had, but that was all that came out."
I had been feeling frustrated about that, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like you're trying to say all sorts of things, but don't bother.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I can pretty much tell
just by looking at your face.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...That's enough.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No, like I said!
I'm telling you your face is "too loud"!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah, come on, it's about time to go, look!!

text_block_list.name: Red-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text: ......Taishin-san.

text_block_list.name: Red-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
That was incredible... so incredible...!!
I... I want to, too...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, w-what's wrong, are you okay!?
Are you... crying...?

Narita Taishin brilliantly won the Satsuki Sho.
However, the Classic campaign has only just begun.

With our sights set on the second crown, the Japanese Derby,
the days of training begin anew...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ......Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"She was so strong...! So strong, so strong,
aaaaaaaagh...!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: —Still!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: If nothing else, the Derby... The Japan Derby is the one race I cannot lose!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna wiiiinnnn!!
